title: Figs and Sycamores
summary: Fig and sycamore trees were common in the land and appear in provision, prophetic imagery, and Gospel scenes.
background: Fig trees supplied food and shade. Sycamore fig trees also appear in Amos and Zacchaeus’ encounter with Jesus.
teachingHelp: Use tree background to locate the scene in ordinary land and agriculture before drawing the passage’s lesson.
